description: Yandex Managed YDB: serverless or dedicated database, its presets, scaling and storage.

fields.name: type
fields.description: serverless = pay-per-request, YC-managed endpoint, no VPC; dedicated = a sized cluster in your network.
fields.title: Database type

fields.name: location_id
fields.description: YC location the database is created in (location_id on both resources).
fields.title: Availability zone group

fields.name: resource_preset_id
fields.description: VM configuration of one database node: vCPUs and RAM.
fields.title: Resource preset

fields.name: scale_policy
fields.description: fixed = a constant number of nodes; auto = YC scales between min and max on CPU utilization (a preview feature, needs the enable_autoscaling label).
fields.title: Scale policy

fields.name: node_count
fields.description: scale_policy.fixed_scale.size — database slots; production guidance is at least three.
fields.title: Nodes

fields.name: auto_scale
fields.description: Target-tracking autoscaling bounds; only read when scale_policy is auto.

fields.name: cpu_utilization_percent
fields.description: scale_policy.auto_scale.target_tracking.cpu_utilization_percent — the utilization YC scales to hold.
fields.title: Target CPU
Auto scale

fields.name: storage_groups
fields.description: storage_config.group_count — for the ssd type one group stores up to 100 GB, so size this from the dataset.
fields.title: Storage groups

fields.name: storage_type
fields.description: storage_config.storage_type_id; YC documents ssd by example and defers the full list to `yc ydb storage-type list`, so other ids are accepted.
fields.title: Storage type

fields.name: assign_public_ips
fields.description: Give the dedicated database nodes public addresses; only meaningful for a dedicated database (serverless has no VPC attachment).
fields.title: Public IPs

fields.name: throttling_rcu_limit
fields.description: serverless_database.throttling_rcu_limit — request units per second ceiling; 0 disables throttling.
fields.title: Throttling RCU limit

fields.name: provisioned_rcu_limit
fields.description: serverless_database.provisioned_rcu_limit — reserved RU/s billed hourly; 0 disables provisioned capacity.
fields.title: Provisioned RCU limit

fields.name: storage_size_limit_gb
fields.description: serverless_database.storage_size_limit — the database's data ceiling (YC default 50 GB).
fields.title: Storage limit

fields.name: deletion_protection
fields.description: Refuse terraform destroy on the database; a kept stand still tears down its VMs, so leave this off unless the data matters.
fields.title: Deletion protection

rules.message: a dedicated database with fewer than three slots has no redundancy
one ssd storage group holds about 100 GB — a larger dataset needs more groups
